name: cowork-space-scout
description: Scouts coworking-space web design and interactive architectural showcases from Awwwards and design hubs, deep-dives the top pick (scrape, tech stack, full-page preview), and aggregates a JSON shortlist of URLs, tech stacks, and preview assets. Paid per call across mixed rails (routed x402 via Perplexity / BuiltWith / ScreenshotOne + MPP on Tempo via Exa / Parallel / Firecrawl) via selat-pay (USDC via Circle Gateway), no API keys.

topic.description: The core discovery subject (used as ${topic} in the Perplexity, Exa, Product Hunt, and Twitter queries). Pan for architecture/interior focus: try '3d coworking space site', 'coworking space architecture portfolio', 'coworking interior design showcase'. Add a city for geography, e.g. 'coworking space website design Berlin'.

showcaseUrl.description: The top showcase URL the agent deep-dives (Firecrawl extract + ScreenshotOne preview). MUST be overridden to the best pick surfaced by the discovery steps; the default is only a fallback so verify can exercise the steps.

domain.description: The domain of the top pick for the BuiltWith tech-stack step. MUST be overridden to the top pick's real domain.

steps.label: design-hub discovery — Perplexity /search domain-filtered to Awwwards + design hubs (routed x402)
web discovery — Exa neural search (MPP on Tempo)
product discovery — Parallel Product Hunt search (MPP on Tempo)
design chatter — SELAT Twitter advanced_search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
depth on the top pick — Firecrawl /v1/extract (MPP on Tempo)

body.prompt: Describe this coworking space's web design: layout, typography, color palette, 3D / interactive / WebGL features, architectural showcase elements, and branding. Return concise bullet points.

steps.label: tech stack of the top pick — BuiltWith /builtwith/domain (routed x402)
preview asset — ScreenshotOne full-page screenshot (routed x402)
